0022600197.text: The Los Angeles Lakers, 7-2 and first in the Pacific, arrive for their 11th game of the season on a three-game winning streak and a 3-1 road record. Detroit, 6-2 and first in the Central, is on a one-game losing streak and is without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), both listed as out. The Lakers lost both meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently a 113-110 defeat in Detroit on March 23, 2026, and the teams have not yet played each other this season.
